26235-the-mistress-of-shenstone.title: The Mistress Of Shenstone
26235-the-mistress-of-shenstone.creator: Florence L. Barclay
26235-the-mistress-of-shenstone.description: A book by Florence L. Barclay. The great trees in Shenstone Park stood gaunt and bare, spreading wide arms over the sodden grass. All nature seemed waiting the first fall of winter's snow, which should hide its deadness and decay under a lovely pall of sparkling white, beneath which a promise of fresh life to come might gently move and stir; and, eventually, spring forth.

arxiv-2101-05596.title: Modelling the Spreading of the SARS-CoV-2 in Presence of the Lockdown and Quarantine Measures by a ”Kinetic-Type Reactions” Approach
arxiv-2101-05596.creator: SONNINO Giorgio, PEETERS Philippe, NARDONE Pasquale
arxiv-2101-05596.description: Abstract We propose a realistic model for the evolution of the COVID-19 pandemic subject to the lockdown and quarantine measures, which takes into account the time-delay for recovery or death processes. The dynamic equations for the entire process are derived by adopting a kinetic-type reactions approach.

arxiv-2204-07088.title: Superoscillations Made Super Simple
arxiv-2204-07088.creator: Gerard McCaul, Peisong Peng, Monica Ortiz Martinez, Dustin Lindberg, Diyar Talbayev, Denys I. Bondar
arxiv-2204-07088.description: Abstract In ordinary circumstances the highest frequency present in a wave is the highest frequency in its Fourier decomposition. It is however possible for there to be a spatial or temporal region of the wave which locally oscillates at a still greater frequency, in a phenomenon known as superoscillation [ 1 ] .

arxiv-2508-00217.title: Tabular Data Understanding with LLMs: A Survey of Recent Advances and Challenges
arxiv-2508-00217.creator: Xiaofeng Wu, Alan Ritter, Wei Xu
arxiv-2508-00217.description: Abstract Tables have gained significant attention in large language models (LLMs) and multimodal large language models (MLLMs) due to their complex and flexible structure. Unlike linear text inputs, tables are two-dimensional, encompassing formats that range from well-structured database tables to complex, multi-layered spreadsheets, each with different purposes.

arxiv-2602-09897.title: Homotopy types of fine curve and fine arc complexes
arxiv-2602-09897.creator: Ryan Dickmann, Zachary Himes, Alexander Nolte, and Roberta Shapiro
arxiv-2602-09897.description: Abstract . The fine curve complex of a surface is a simplicial complex whose vertices are essential simple closed curves and whose k k -simplices are collections of k + 1 k+1 disjoint curves. We prove that the fine curve complex is homotopy equivalent to the curve complex. We also prove that the fine arc complex is contractible. 1.

pmc-10553497.title: SAT267 BMP4, GDF11 And TGFβ2 Repress Adrenal Cell Cortisol Production By Blocking CYP17A1 And CYP11B1 Expression
pmc-10553497.creator: Emily Catherine Fischbach, Antoine-Guy Lopez, Matthew Ullenbruch, Juilee Rege, William E Rainey
pmc-10553497.description: Disclosure: E.C. Fischbach: None. A. Lopez: None. M. Ullenbruch: None. J. Rege: None. W.E. Rainey: None. Introduction: The adrenal cortex is responsible for the biosynthesis of multiple steroid hormones that regulate electrolyte and carbohydrate balance. Cortisol, the principal glucocorticoid in humans, is primarily produced in the middle zone of the cortex known as the zona fasciculata (ZF).

pmc-10583584.title: Formin protein FMNL1 is a biomarker for tumor-infiltrating immune cells and associated with well immunotherapeutic response
pmc-10583584.creator: Guomin Lu, Hui Wang, Rui Xu, Junying Xu, Fangmei An, Haoran Xu, He Nie, Jie Mei, Qiang Zhan, Qinglin Zhang
pmc-10583584.description: Background: Increased studies on the basis of bulk RNA-sequencing (RNA-seq) data of cancer identify numbers of immune-related genes which may play potential regulatory roles in the tumor microenvironment (TME) without in-depth validation.Methods: In the current study, the immunological correlation and cell subpopulation expression pattern of FMNL1 were analyzed using public data.

pmc-10669989.title: The Physical and Structural Effects of 1-MCP on Four Different Apple Cultivars during Storage
pmc-10669989.creator: Valentina J L Ting, Pat Silcock, Franco Biasioli, Phil Bremer, José Sousa Câmara, Rosaria Cozzolino
pmc-10669989.description: The impact of the ethylene inhibitor, 1-methylcyclopropene (1-MCP), on four apple cultivars (Braeburn, Fuji, Jazz and Golden Delicious) over 150 days of storage at 2 °C was assessed. Proton transfer reaction quadrupole mass spectrometry (PTR-QUAD-MS) was used to monitor changes in VOC composition, while texture analysis and X-ray microcomputer tomography (µ-CT) scanning were used to study microstructural changes.

pmc-11345000.title: Inter-subspecies diversity of maize to drought stress with physio-biochemical, enzymatic and molecular responses
pmc-11345000.creator: Gokhan Eskikoy, Imren Kutlu
pmc-11345000.description: BackgroundDrought is the most significant factor limiting maize production, given that maize is a crop with a high water demand. Therefore, studies investigating the mechanisms underlying the drought tolerance of maize are of great importance. There are no studies comparing drought tolerance among economically important subspecies of maize.

pmc-11520182.title: Cross-institutional evaluation of deep learning and radiomics models in predicting microvascular invasion in hepatocellular carcinoma: validity, robustness, and ultrasound modality efficacy comparison
pmc-11520182.creator: Weibin Zhang, Qihui Guo, Yuli Zhu, Meng Wang, Tong Zhang, Guangwen Cheng, Qi Zhang, Hong Ding
pmc-11520182.description: PurposeTo conduct a head-to-head comparison between deep learning (DL) and radiomics models across institutions for predicting microvascular invasion (MVI) in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and to investigate the model robustness and generalizability through rigorous internal and external validation.MethodsThis retrospective study included 2304 preoperative images of 576 HCC lesions from two centers, with MVI status determined by postoperative histopathology.

pmc-11775906.title: An effective drift-diffusion model for pandemic propagation and uncertainty prediction
pmc-11775906.creator: Clara Bender, Abhimanyu Ghosh, Hamed Vakili, Preetam Ghosh, Avik W Ghosh
pmc-11775906.description: Predicting pandemic evolution involves complex modeling challenges, typically involving detailed discrete mathematics executed on large volumes of epidemiological data. Making them physics based provides added intuition as well as predictive value. Differential equations have the advantage of offering smooth, well-behaved solutions that try to capture overall predictive trends and averages.

pmc-12500877.title: Shared neuroimaging and molecular profiles in type 2 diabetes mellitus and major depressive disorder: an integrative analysis of genetic, transcriptomic, and neuroimaging data
pmc-12500877.creator: Jinglei Xu, Xin Du, Ying Zhai, Qiyu Zhao, Yang Zhang, Haolin Wang, Yue Wu, Yanmin Peng, Feng Liu, Quan Zhang
pmc-12500877.description: Type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) and major depressive disorder (MDD) are prevalent chronic conditions that frequently co-occur, suggesting potential shared mechanisms. Neuroimaging meta-analyses were conducted to identify gray matter volume (GMV) alterations in T2DM and MDD, with further identification of the overlapping regions between the two diseases.

pmc-13070083.title: A Robust Finite Element Method for Linearized Magnetohydrodynamics on General Domains
pmc-13070083.creator: L Beirão da Veiga, C Lovadina, M Trezzi
pmc-13070083.description: We generalize and improve the finite element method for linearized Magnetohydrodynamics introduced in (Beirão da Veiga et al., SIAM J. Numer. Anal. 62(4):1539–1564 (2024)). The main novelty is that the proposed scheme is able to handle also non-convex domains and less regular solutions.

pmc-13120391.title: Automated Assembly of Large-Scale Aerospace Components: A Structured Narrative Survey of Emerging Technologies
pmc-13120391.creator: Kuai Zhou, Wenmin Chu, Peng Zhao, Xiaoxu Ji, Lulu Huang
pmc-13120391.description: Large-scale aerospace components (e.g., wings, fuselage sections, wing boxes, and rocket segments) feature large dimensions, low stiffness, complex interfaces, and strict assembly tolerances. Traditional rigid tooling and manual alignment struggle to meet the demands of high precision, efficiency, and flexibility in modern aerospace manufacturing.

pmc-13335030.title: Early urinary decompression and mortality in septic obstructing ureteral stones: a nationwide comparative-effectiveness study
pmc-13335030.creator: Mohamed Mahmoud Dogha, Atef A Hassan, Osama Mostafa Mohamed, Mahmoud Farag, Islam S Nouh, Mohamed Hamdy Ibrahim, Assem Abdelaziz Mesbah, Mohamed F Elebiary, Nader A Abdelkhalek, Adel Moalwi
pmc-13335030.description: BackgroundSeptic obstructing ureteral stones are a time-critical urological emergency. Although urgent drainage is recommended, uncertainty persists regarding the comparative effectiveness of decompression strategies and the influence of timing in real-world practice.MethodsWe analyzed adults with sepsis or septic shock and obstructing ureteral stones (n = 9,172) from the U.S. HCUP National Inpatient Sample (2016–2022).

pmc-13412289.title: GC-MS-Based Metabolomics Provides Insights into the Biochemical Peculiarity of Seven Brown Algal Species of the Order Fucales
pmc-13412289.creator: Elena Tarakhovskaya, Ekaterina Gulk, Bochao Yang, Paula Schliebe, Susan Billig, Claudia Wiesner
pmc-13412289.description: Brown algae are important primary producers in coastal ecosystems, where they provide habitat and food for numerous marine species. For humans, they provide raw materials (food, animal feed, and ingredients for pharmaceuticals and cosmetics) as well as ecosystem services such as coastal protection and carbon sequestration.

pmc-13438380.title: Temporal structure of national vs. world-level taekwondo competitions: a time-motion analysis in taekwondo
pmc-13438380.creator: Hongwei Yan, Yuqiao Zhu, Hu Chen, Linguo Chen, Wang Ren, Qing Guo, Zhenghe Guo, HuiMeng Dong, Junli Yang, Qinjian Xu, Taining An
pmc-13438380.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). PurposeInternational taekwondo competition has undergone substantial rule-driven intensification in recent years, yet empirical evidence regarding how Chinese athletes temporally adapt to these demands relative to global elites remains scarce. This study compared the temporal structure of the 2025 Chinese National Games (CNG) and 2025 Wuxi World Taekwondo Championships (WWC) to quantify differences in High intensity activities(HIA), Low intenisty activities(LIA), Referee pause(RP), and Effort: Pause(E:P) ratios.MethodsTime-motion analysis was used on 171 rounds (75 matches) of gold-medal bouts.

pmc-13447478.title: Integrating genomic features for prognosis in Chinese patients with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma following R-CHOP therapy
pmc-13447478.creator: Shi Han, Linghui Zhou, Haiqiong Zheng, Yi Zhao, Zhen Cai, Jingsong He, Xiujin Ye, Wenjun Wu, Jie Sun, Weiyan Zheng, Guoqing Wei, Li Yu, Lixin Wang, Ke Gao, Juan Yue, Mingming Zhang, Yongxian Hu, He Huang
pmc-13447478.description: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) exhibits 30–40% rates of relapse or refractory disease after R-CHOP. Identifying patients at risk for treatment failure is essential for planning subsequent therapeutic strategies, including stem cell mobilization or cellular therapy. To identify genomic predictors in Chinese patients, we performed targeted sequencing of tumor and matched oral DNA from 147 cases.
